# Browser fixtures

Public read-only snapshot of the existing habitat, day106/watchIII/revision26, captured on 7 September2026. These files contain fictional residents and their public observer projection. They are test input only: they cannot restore the full private engine state and are never sent to the live service.

Browser tests intercept every runtime endpoint and use these fixtures. No model call, clock advance, administrator operation or secret is needed. Negative-path cases override the relevant response locally.
